name: procurement-api
description: The single backend the web app calls (P2). Owns purchase requests, approvals (limit = APPROVAL_LIMIT_DEFAULT, 500000 minor units when unset, for every approver, with optional per-username overrides in APPROVAL_LIMITS as username=amount pairs; no screen manages them), and goods receipts, and fronts the catalogue, stock, ledger and low-stock views by calling the inventory service. Gateway-protected; resolves the caller from the signed assertion and enforces own-rows access under /me paths. Does NOT store stock or ledger data itself, send notifications, or run background jobs. Request and receipt persistence is held in-service until a database resource is available in the organization catalog.

dependencies.name: inventory-service
dependencies.description: Reads and writes items, stock levels and the ledger; the only caller of the inventory service.
